description:
## Mandatory context and boundaries
Read the parent epic first. Applicable owners: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md; docs/services/channels.md (communication/Jido bridge and provider contracts); docs/services/engine.md (history, admission, finalization and delivery). Read docs/documentation.md before documentation/skill edits, docs/services/system-config.md before credential fixtures, and local module @moduledoc before extending a helper. Apply code-quality for code and skill-creator for the skill.
Only test/ additions or backward-compatible support changes, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, and .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** are authorized. Do not edit application modules, dependency source/pins, config, migrations, mix.exs, CI, or unrelated skills. Existing-test expectation changes require the testing handbook's explicit approval; this epic authorizes additive coverage, not changing expectations.
Use real bridges, NodeRouter, Engine admission/history/persistence and configured Agent execution. Only provider/LLM boundaries are faked. A production defect is a reported blocker with a reproducer; do not patch production, silently omit a scenario, weaken an assertion, or close the issue as complete.
Validation timing, failure handling and final gates are owned by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Record executed commands/results in this issue. No new browser E2E is needed: this work adds test/developer infrastructure without changing a deployed UI journey. No commit/push/merge authorization is implied.

Parent epic: zaq-o9d

## Functional specification and review scope
Review all implementation from preceding children as one usable workflow, then record actual review approval before the dedicated coverage handoff. No new feature expansion is authorized. Fix only in-scope defects, updating the owning issue/tests when necessary.
Review surfaces:
- Driver callback/Session schemas agree with all three drivers, generator templates and skill.
- Registry is the single test-provider list; all shared tests enumerate it; every initial provider is present and no required case is skipped/default-excluded.
- Native ingress reaches real bridges/Engine/Agent and external delivery; fake provider scripts are strict and do not insert answers/transcripts or bypass authorization.
- Real transcript reads verify direct/shared content/order/scope/access and delivery confirmation, with permission setup that does not mask automatic-grant behaviour.
- Existing WhatsApp wrapper is reused, saved-connector path is unchanged, and fake failure additions preserve legacy consumers.
- All full-runtime state is isolated/restored and completion waits are event-based. No broad test sleeps/polling or unrelated process teardown.
- Generator only creates test files/registry entries, cannot start the app/DB, and cannot overwrite or escape output paths.
- Skill is in .agents/skills and requires ALL drivers to pass.
- Allowed diff paths are test/**, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** only. The generator/skill exceptions do not authorize other lib/ or agent-guidance edits.
Use the repository PR-review workflow when a PR exists or review the branch/diff locally if not. Do not publish a PR/comment or merge without existing authorization. Record reviewer, revision/diff basis, findings and resolution evidence. This review is not the final human approval after coverage.

## Tests to add before fixes / branches validated
For each concrete defect, add a focused reproducer before its in-scope fix. Retest only changed/affected paths and the required all-provider integration matrix; do not mechanically repeat broad checks without cause. At minimum review evidence from:
mix test test/zaq/channels/integration
mix test test/mix/tasks/zaq_test_gen_channel_test.exs
Relevant existing Mattermost/Telegram/WhatsApp/support consumers.
Follow quality/check timing in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; keep logs in Context Mode.

## Mocking plan
Do not replace internals during review. Any temporary review probes must use the same external-only boundary and clean up.

## Documentation
Complete test README examples and gap reporting, correct task help/skill references in their permitted files, and record review findings/results in this issue. Do not update broad repository docs or skills as incidental cleanup.

## Action reuse assessment
Verify the parent/child reuse decisions against final code: no duplicate application Actions/flows, no new tools, existing fake/helper consumers preserved. Review-only work has no new domain operation.

## Done when
All material review findings are resolved, relevant checks pass, the diff satisfies the scope allowlist, and actual review approval is recorded. Only then may the next coverage/finalization issue start. If app changes are necessary, report a scope blocker rather than silently changing the epic.
title: [zaq-o9d.11] Review the complete harness, generator and skill against the agreed scope
